cohort: 137 Iranian women with singleton term pregnancies, aged 18-45 years, gestational age between 38-41 weeks, no history of systemic diseases, non-smokers, and non-drinkers.
finding: CPR was significantly associated with AFI, arterial cord pH, base excess, Apgar score at minute 1 and 5, neonatal cord pH, NICU admission rate, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Fetal distress was the most important indication for cesarean delivery in all CPR groups (35.13%, 21.21% and 11.8% respectively).
